description: Paid: 0.003 RLUSD per call via x402 on XRPL mainnet (xrpl:0), or 0.003 USDC on Base (eip155:8453). Agent access-policy readings for one tracked domain, raw readings first: robots.txt groups for named AI-agent user-agents and the * group, Content-Signal values, llms.txt presence and title, /.well-known JSON files, security.txt fields and TDM headers. Each reading has source URL, fetch time (UTC), HTTP status, SHA-256 of the bytes received and 7-day change events. File text is not redistributed. A reading may be a gap (HTTP 404, HTTP 403 to our fetcher, or skipped because robots.txt disallows our fetcher). Tracked domains: free index GET https://api.agentweather.io/v1/access-policy/index; other domains get an error before any payment. Without payment this returns isError with the x402 PaymentRequired object (fresh invoiceId); retry with the signed payload in _meta["x402/payment"] or the payment_signature argument. Unpaid calls cost nothing.

domain.description: Tracked domain from the free index /v1/access-policy/index, e.g. cloudflare.com

payment_signature.description: Optional. Base64 x402 PAYMENT-SIGNATURE value (signed RLUSD or USDC PaymentPayload) for hosts that cannot set _meta["x402/payment"]. Omit on the first call to receive the payment requirements.

name: get_access_policy_reading
title: Agent access-policy readings for one domain (paid: 0.003 RLUSD / 0.003 USDC on Base / 0.003 RLUSD on Base via x402)
